profiles.description: Meet the Siberian long tailed tit, a tiny adorable fluffball with double eyelids.

SECONDED is a verification layer for AI agents. Before your agent moves money, two rival AI models check the action. If they don't agree, you don't pay. Every answer is signed.

Five checks from $0.25, paid per call with x402 on Base, Arc and Robinhood Chain. Live for agents now.

$SECONDED: fixed supply, no owner, no mint. The team burned its full 2% launch buy. 0.5% of every trade goes to buying back and burning $SECONDED.
